verdict.summary: marius-patrik/Andromeda issue #217 at version 483ca4f5fc0c8b98d8428755eb11969c34cc6df029d4a5a26ee70fdd5de27f1c is well-bounded but not implementation-ready: seven owner decisions remain unresolved and the required dependency revisions are not yet merged and evidenced.

blockingFindings.title: Required owner decisions O217-1 through O217-7 remain unresolved
blockingFindings.details: The exact issue contract blocks implementation and release publication pending authenticated owner answers for O217-1 through O217-7. These decisions determine canonical implementation ownership, the supported-platform matrix, default logical-tier behavior, signing and trust policy, stale-launcher migration, manifest freshness, and archive admission. The supplied owner comment is truncated and resolves none of them. Required action: obtain authenticated, issue-specific answers for every applicable decision and completely re-review the resulting issue version.

blockingFindings.title: Blocking dependency chain lacks merged exact-revision evidence
blockingFindings.details: The contract requires #253, #260, and #275 to be merged on their default branches with green required checks and exact consumed revisions bound to #217 validation. Verified state shows #253 and #275 open. Although #260 is closed and claims to close #253, that conflicts with #253's live open state, and no exact merged revisions, ancestry proof, required-check evidence, or consumption binding is provided. Required action: reconcile #253, complete #275, and record exact default-branch revisions and associated evidence before admitting CLI/TUI implementation or release integration.

nonBlockingNotes: The live labels P1 and df:ask-owner match the issue's durable blocked-state requirement, and df:reviewed is absent.

The corrected contract clearly separates runtime-owned route resolution from CLI/TUI rendering and provides substantial validation, failure, rollout, rollback, installer, updater, signature, and archive boundaries.
